description: Manages one connected integration account, named by id; the account returns no credential. action update takes name and config (non-secret settings only). action test makes one safe read at the provider and returns whether the credential works; a failed test is an answer with ok false. action add_number (connection_id) uses the account on another WhatsApp number of the workspace, the same sign-in and not a copy. action remove_number (connection_id) stops using the account on one number (refused on its only number, and while an automation switched on there needs it), and only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve. Signing in, and typing or replacing a key, happen on a set-up link the person opens; deleting an account or its saved login is done by a person in the Cosend dashboard. Owners and admins.

action.description: update renames the account or changes its non-secret config. test verifies the credential. add_number and remove_number choose the WhatsApp numbers the account serves.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The connection_id in the resource path.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: manage_integration
title: Manage an integration account
